newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 584,100 metric tons (MT) were one-tenth over the prior week. Major increases were recorded for unknown destinations (149,800 MT), the Philippines (106,000 MT), South Korea (83,600 MT), Japan (51,000 MT), and Jamaica (32,500 MT).

Exports of 428,100 MT were 2 percent above the prior week and 29 percent over the 4-week average. Pakistan (110,000 MT), South Korea (64,800 MT), the Philippines (46,900 MT), Morocco (36,500 MT), Yemen (36,000 MT), and Jordan (30,100 MT) were the main destinations.
